repository_summary: The README for Aspose.3D FOSS for TypeScript describes a TypeScript/JavaScript library for 3D file format manipulation. It includes installation, quick start, supported formats, documentation, build/test instructions, format-specific features, architecture, examples, contributing, license, and acknowledgments sections. The repository is verified as a TypeScript package (@aspose/3d) supporting OBJ, GLTF, STL, 3MF, FBX, and Collada formats, with a clear open-source scope and commercial upgrade path.
